crossRefs.note: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel; nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.
Hasn’t the same Hezekiah taken away his high places and his altars, and commanded Judah and Jerusalem, saying, ‘You…
He walked in all the way of Asa his father. He didn’t turn away from it, doing that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes.…
However the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.

translations.web: Nevertheless the people sacrificed still in the high places, but only to Yahweh their God.
translations.bsb: Nevertheless, the people still sacrificed at the high places, but only to the LORD their God.
translations.kjv: Nevertheless the people did sacrifice still in the high places, yet unto the LORD their God only.
translations.asv: Nevertheless the people sacrificed still in the high places, but only unto Jehovah their God.
